meta.title: Modernize repository to use vite
meta.body_summary: Migrate build system from Webpack 4 to Vite, convert AMD modules to ES6, and switch testing from Karma to Vitest for improved development experience and performance.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor migrated build to Vite/ES6; merged by author without review after one human fix commit; no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 15,339 changed lines across 31 files, this is a large-scale build system modernization. It fits a significant infrastructure change that was merged without external review after a human fix-up commit, reflecting the author/maintainer's acceptance of the agent's work.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or PR comments; maintainer (also PR author) made a follow-up commit to fix issues, then merged.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved development experience and performance via Vite migration.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large build system migration (Webpack 4 to Vite, AMD to ES6, Karma to Vitest) with many file changes; the agent managed the bulk but required a human fix commit to correct issues, indicating some gaps in full migration quality.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer likely reviewed code, identified issues, and committed fixes (c79d4ac).

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks or reproducibility steps provided; only a summary markdown file.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer committed 'Fix issues of modernization by agent' (c79d4ac) addressing unspecified problems before merge.

core_change_summary.description: Migrated build system from Webpack 4 to Vite, converted AMD modules to ES6 imports/exports, switched test runner from Karma to Vitest, updated ESLint config, removed deprecated configs, and regenerated dist files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Massive changes in yarn.lock reflect dependency updates; dist files regenerated by Vite.
change_trajectory: Initial agent commit (c3c4eaf) performed the full migration: added Vite config, removed Webpack configs, converted AMD to ES6, updated package scripts and dependencies, regenerated dist.
Maintainer fix commit (c79d4ac) addressed issues: added eslint.config.js, updated several dist files, fixed example HTML files, and modified source and config files.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent authored the entire migration in a single large commit.
Maintainer rlamana, also the PR author, made a follow-up fix commit without any discussion.
PR merged by rlamana after ~2 days with no external reviews or comments.
